paper_metadata.title: The present work shows that the microstructural grain structure with a grain size much below 100 nm can be produced in large bulk material by severe plastic deformation, such as multi-step forging, at elevated temperatures. The formation of a submicrocrystalline structure shows similar values of strain rate sensitivity, elongation and low-stress at room temperature of 500 °C. The high strain rate sensitivity in the submicrocrystalline line can be retained during deformation at 400 °C.
